title: Everyday Phrases — An Escape Room
scene_zh: 密室逃脫 · 情境對話
title_quote: Let's book an escape room tonight.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🔐 實用密室逃脫必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — An Escape Room
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用密室逃脫情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從線上訂場次、挑主題、問人數時段價格和新手難度、遲到與置物櫃規定，到開場規則講解、不能暴力硬拆、拿對講機求助、分頭翻箱找線索、讀題面，再到解數字鎖、拼圖、紫外線筆、湊四位密碼、看倒數、用掉一次提示、卡住換思路，最後通關合影、看成績排名與用時、復盤哪步最過癮、推薦給朋友、再訂更難的主題，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical An Escape Room phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering booking a session online, choosing a theme, asking about group size, times, price and beginner difficulty, late arrival and locker rules, then the opening rules talk, never forcing anything, using the walkie-talkie for help, splitting up to search and reading the clues, solving number locks, jigsaws and a UV pen, building a four-digit code, watching the countdown, spending one hint and switching approach when stuck, and finally escaping, the team photo, the leaderboard time, reviewing the best step, recommending it to friends and booking a harder theme. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's book an escape room tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚訂一間密室逃脫吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I love puzzles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which theme do you want?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pirate ship looks fun.
dialogue.zh: 海盜船那間看起來很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the haunted house tempts me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is too scary for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz tu ˈskɛri fər ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 那間對我們來說太嚇人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's also a mystery detective room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, solving a crime sounds cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's pick the detective theme then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice for our first time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people can join a team?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl kæn dʒɔɪn ə tim?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to six players per room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we book for just four?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four is a perfect number.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we invite Sam and Lily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the more the merrier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What times are available tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven or nine, which is better?
dialogue.zh: 七點或九點，哪個比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's take the seven o'clock slot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That gives us time for dinner.
dialogue.zh: 這樣我們還有時間吃晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does it cost per person?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ɪt kɔst pər ˈpɜrsən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five dollars for each player.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that price for the whole team?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt praɪs fər ðə hoʊl tim?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's charged per person.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So four of us pay one hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ fɔr ʌv ʌs peɪ wʌn ˈhʌndrəd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that's a fair deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any discount if we're all students?
dialogue.zh: 如果我們全是學生有折扣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, five dollars off each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pay by card right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi peɪ baɪ kɑrd raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在可以刷卡付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay online now, or at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ ɑnˈlaɪn naʊ, ɔr æt ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 線上付或到現場付都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this room hard for beginners?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's rated medium, so it's okay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None of us have done one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then start with an easier theme.
dialogue.zh: 那就從簡單一點的主題開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which room is the easiest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The garden mystery is the mildest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the detective room tempts me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll just have to try.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much time do we have in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ taɪm du wi hæv ɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們在裡面有多少時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty minutes on the clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do most teams actually win?
dialogue.zh: 大多數隊伍真的能過關嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About half make it out in time.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt hæf meɪk ɪt aʊt ɪn taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half sounds a little discouraging.
dialogue.zh: 一半的機率，聽起來有點令人灰心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, we'll do fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens when time runs out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Staff open the door and walk you out.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæf ˈoʊpən ðə dɔr ænd wɔk ju aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 工作人員會開門帶你們出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to arrive early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please come fifteen minutes early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we need to be early?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du wi nid tu bi ˈɜrli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a quick rules talk first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we show up late?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late teams can lose game time.
dialogue.zh: 遲到的隊伍會損失遊戲時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's plan to leave early then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, traffic is awful around seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I text the group the details?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɛkst ðə ɡrup ðə ˈdiˌteɪlz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, send them the address too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any age limit for this game?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids under ten need an adult.
dialogue.zh: 十歲以下需要家長陪同。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I confirm my booking online?
dialogue.zh: 我要在線上確認訂位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your email for a code.
dialogue.zh: 查看你的郵件，裡面有入場代碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, seven works despite traffic.
dialogue.zh: 儘管塞車，七點還是合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, we'll simply leave early.
dialogue.zh: 同意，我們提早出發就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we cancel if plans change?
dialogue.zh: 如果計劃有變，我們能取消嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's free to cancel up to twenty-four hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fri tu ˈkænsəl ʌp tu ˈtwɛnti fɔr ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 提前二十四小時可免費取消。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We might bring snacks, is that fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi maɪt brɪŋ snæks, ɪz ðæt faɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可能帶點心，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No food inside, but the lobby's okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fuːd ɪnˈsaɪd, bət ðə ˈlɑbiz oʊˈkeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there parking near the building?
dialogue.zh: 大樓附近有位子停車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small lot behind it.
dialogue.zh: 有，後面有一個小停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I print anything for this?
dialogue.zh: 我需要列印什麼資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, show it on your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we leave our bags?
dialogue.zh: 我們的包包可以放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are free lockers by the entrance.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɑr fri ˈlɑkərz baɪ ði ˈɛntrəns./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we store our phones too?
dialogue.zh: 我們的手機也要收起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, no phones inside the room.
dialogue.zh: 請收好，房內不能帶手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my watch on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watches are fine, jewelry maybe not.
dialogue.zh: 手錶沒問題，首飾可能不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have to sign anything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a short waiver at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ʃɔrt ˈweɪvər æt ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 只需在櫃台簽個同意書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the room hot or cold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's air-conditioned, bring a layer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wear fancy clothes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, comfy clothes work best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we take our water in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sealed bottles only, no open cups.
dialogue.zh: 只能帶封口的瓶子，不能開口杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we touch the props inside?
dialogue.zh: 裡面的道具可以隨便摸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything's meant to be handled.
dialogue.zh: 所有東西都是可以動的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the escape room in English?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all clues are in English.
dialogue.zh: 是的，所有線索都是英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My English is only so-so.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clues use very easy words.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will someone guide us if we're lost?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ˈsʌmwʌn ɡaɪd ʌs ɪf wɪr lɔst?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我們卡住會有人帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A host watches through the camera.
dialogue.zh: 主持人會從攝影機看你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we get totally stuck?
dialogue.zh: 如果我們完全卡住了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get three hints, that's plenty.
dialogue.zh: 你們有三次提示，很夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I already feel a little nervous.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, but mostly excited.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, our booking is confirmed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, see you there at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am counting down the minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is going to be so fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bi soʊ fʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Welcome, here's how your game works.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，遊戲是這樣進行的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we're ready to listen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your goal is to escape the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ɡoʊl ɪz tu ɪˈskeɪp ðə ruːm./
dialogue.zh: 你們的目標是逃出房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we have one hour, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Correct, the clock starts now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, let's beat that timer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please never force anything open.
dialogue.zh: 請千萬不要硬撬開東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no pulling or kicking hard?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, nothing needs real strength.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we'll be gentle with props.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't use tools on the locks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No screwdrivers or keys from home?
dialogue.zh: 不能自備螺絲起子或鑰匙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, every lock opens by clues.
dialogue.zh: 對，每把鎖都靠線索打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That keeps every team on track.
dialogue.zh: 這樣每支隊伍起點都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please don't tear paper or books.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We promise, no tearing anything.
dialogue.zh: 我們保證不撕任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's a walkie-talkie for help.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do we press it to talk?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the button and speak clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, we'll call if stuck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We also watch you on camera.
dialogue.zh: 我們也會用攝影機看你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you can help us anytime?
dialogue.zh: 那你們隨時都能幫我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, message us through the speaker.
dialogue.zh: 是的，透過喇叭跟我們說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that feels less stressful.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這樣壓力小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hints cost thirty seconds each.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small price to keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember, no phones in here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stored them all in lockers.
dialogue.zh: 我們全都放在寄物櫃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The emergency exit is behind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good to know where it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If you feel uneasy, just leave.
dialogue.zh: 如果覺得不舒服，就可以離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, we're calm so far.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我們目前很冷靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, the room is all yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's split up and search.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You take the desk, I'll do shelves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju teɪk ðə dɛsk, aɪl du ʃɛlvz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good, meet back in five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look under mats and behind frames.
dialogue.zh: 看看墊子下面和相框後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, digging into the desk now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found a locked wooden box.
dialogue.zh: 我找到一個上鎖的木盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it have a keyhole?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it wants a number code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a number clue is nearby.
dialogue.zh: 所以數字線索就在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check these old books for marks.
dialogue.zh: 翻翻這些舊書看有無記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This page has one date in red!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs peɪdʒ hæz wʌn deɪt ɪn rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 這一頁有個日期是紅色的！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's probably an important clue.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jot it down on the pad.
dialogue.zh: 我這就把它記在便條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write down clues as you find them.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt daʊn kluz æz ju faɪnd ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 找到線索就馬上寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good tip, memory gets messy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found a map with dates.
dialogue.zh: 我找到一張有日期的地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do the dates mean numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe they match a calendar lock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So where is that calendar lock?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A riddle card says, solve me first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈrɪdəl kɑrd sɛz, sɑlv mi fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 有張謎題卡寫著：先解開我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Answer the riddle, then it opens.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These riddles are strangely worded.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read them slowly, maybe twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have keys, no doors. Hmm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A piano! It has keys.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, let's check the piano now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, a note taped under the keys!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ə noʊt teɪpt ˈʌndər ðə kiːz!/
dialogue.zh: 看，琴鍵下面貼著一張紙條！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read it out, what does it say?
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt aʊt, wʌt dʌz ɪt seɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see letters written small.
dialogue.zh: 我看到寫得很小的字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you read the tiny letters?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says the answer is north.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: North must mean that wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's examine the wall carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a calendar lock on the wall!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ə ˈkæləndər lɑk ɑn ðə wɔl!/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our clue lists several possible dates.
dialogue.zh: 但我們的線索列了好幾個可能日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the circled month and day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It clicked! A panel swung open.
dialogue.zh: 喀嚓一聲，有個面板轉開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside is a small brass key.
dialogue.zh: 裡面是一把小黃銅鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does this small key open?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the drawer by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits! There's more inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check that old shoe on the floor!
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðæt oʊld ʃu ɑn ðə flɔr!/
dialogue.zh: 看看地板上那隻舊鞋子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a note with colored dots!
dialogue.zh: 真的有，一張畫著彩色圓點的紙條！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We split tasks, that's working.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teamwork really saves us time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep talking about what you see.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharing details speeds us up.
dialogue.zh: 分享細節會讓我們更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This photo has a circled year.
dialogue.zh: 這照片上圈了一個年份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, right beside the map dates.
dialogue.zh: 記下了，寫在地圖日期旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This note smells like old paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, don't crumble it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't open this puzzle box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you check for a latch?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a slide on the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, it opens that easily!
dialogue.zh: 啊，原來這麼容易就開了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't overthink every single thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, some clues are simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock shows twenty gone.
dialogue.zh: 計時器顯示已過二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So fast, we need to hurry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's meet at the middle table.
dialogue.zh: 我們到中間那張桌子碰頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring every clue you found.
dialogue.zh: 把你找到的線索都拿來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This magnet letter looks random.
dialogue.zh: 這個字母磁鐵看起來很隨機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe it spells a hidden word.
dialogue.zh: 也許它能拼出一個暗語。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, line them up now.
dialogue.zh: 好點子，現在把它們排一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reads look under the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's lift the mirror and look.
dialogue.zh: 我們把鏡子抬起來看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small box sits underneath!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's focus on the number locks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which numbers should we even try?
dialogue.zh: 我們到底該試哪些數字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The circled dates, remember the map.
dialogue.zh: 是那些圈起來的日期，還記得那張地圖嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, 1821 and some smaller ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, eɪˈtin ˈtwɛnti wʌn ænd sʌm ˈsmɔlər wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 對，一八二一，還有幾個較小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our wooden box wants four digits.
dialogue.zh: 我們的木盒要剛好四位數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we must choose which ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the year from the photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's four digits, worth a shot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll dial one eight two one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈdaɪəl wʌn eɪt tu wʌn naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any beeping? Did it open?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, the light stayed red.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrong code, let's rethink it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't repeat a code that failed.
dialogue.zh: 彆再試已經失敗的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, that wastes our clock.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那會浪費我們的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, this box holds a black light!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðɪs bɑks hoʊldz ə blæk laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 看，這個盒子裡有盞紫光燈！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And an invisible ink pen, too!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shine the light on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are glowing marks hidden here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡藏著會發光的記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see three big numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one tiny number by the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn ˈtaɪni ˈnʌmbər baɪ ði ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 邊緣還有一個很小的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one's easy to miss.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch, note them all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For a code, the order matters.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left to right, or sorted?
dialogue.zh: 從左到右，還是由小到大？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clue says smallest first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So put them from small to big.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ pʊt ðɛm frʌm smɔl tu bɪɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That gives us zero, one, three, seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡɪvz ʌs ˈzɪroʊ, wʌn, θri, ˈsɛvən./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the code for the wooden box!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə koʊd fər ðə ˈwʊdən bɑks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The failed year was just a trap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə feɪld jɪr wʌz dʒʌst ə træp./
dialogue.zh: 那個沒開的年份只是個陷阱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So dial zero, one, three, seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! The wooden box popped open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that was the hard part.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那才是最難的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside sits one small folded card.
dialogue.zh: 裡面躺著一張小摺卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six letters, all mixed up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Across the wall hangs a letter lock.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkrɔs ðə wɔl hæŋz ə ˈlɛtər lɑk./
dialogue.zh: 對面牆上掛著一個字母鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six dials, it wants one word.
dialogue.zh: 六個轉盤，它要一個單詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the card spells that word.
dialogue.zh: 也許卡片拼的就是那個單詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reads like nonsense to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try a few orders first.
dialogue.zh: 我們先試著換幾個順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the lock stays firmly shut.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those dials need one whole word.
dialogue.zh: 那些轉盤需要一個完整的單詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A word lock, that's the final puzzle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɜrd lɑk, ðæts ðə ˈfaɪnəl ˈpʌzəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the card gives no full word.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ðə kɑrd ɡivz noʊ fʊl wɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 可是卡片上不是一個完整的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The answer must hide in the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈænsər mʌst haɪd ɪn ðə rum./
dialogue.zh: 答案一定藏在房間裡的某處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We tried many words, none fit.
dialogue.zh: 我們試了很多單詞，都沒開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the note letters failed us.
dialogue.zh: 連紙條上的字母也沒用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time check, fifteen minutes left.
dialogue.zh: 看一下時間，只剩十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's tight, maybe use a hint?
dialogue.zh: 很緊，也許該用一次提示了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, let's press the walkie-talkie.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, don't waste any time.
dialogue.zh: 決定得好，彆再浪費時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the host, what's wrong?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We need a word for our lock.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə wɜrd fər ˈaʊər lɑk./
dialogue.zh: 我們的鎖需要一個單詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look for the word on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fər ðə wɜrd ɑn ðə ʃɛlf./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A book title! Which one exactly?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue one with a bird.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! Secret is the word.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, that hint helped a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're welcome, keep going.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Secret is six letters, that fits!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the lock shows six empty dials.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə lɑk ʃoʊz sɪks ˈɛmti ˈdaɪəlz./
dialogue.zh: 而且鎖上有六個空轉盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's set the dials, letter by letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sɛt ðə ˈdaɪəlz, ˈlɛtər baɪ ˈlɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 我們一個字母一個字母地轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, one dial slipped back again.
dialogue.zh: 小心，有個轉盤又滑回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, it reset, start once more.
dialogue.zh: 唉，全部重置了，重來一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First three letters: S E C.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the rest, R E T.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, every dial is finally set.
dialogue.zh: 好了，每個轉盤都定位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trying it now, hold your breath.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It clicked open, we did it!
dialogue.zh: 喀一聲開了，我們成功了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, there's a key inside!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the hardest one yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the clock is still running.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We spent one hint, two are left.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi spɛnt wʌn hɪnt, tu ɑr lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 我們用了一次提示，還剩兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let's save them and keep moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts seɪv ðɛm ænd kip ˈmuvɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let's crack that color note.
dialogue.zh: 現在來破解那張顏色紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm stuck, this clue makes no sense.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm stʌk, ðɪs klus meɪks noʊ sɛns./
dialogue.zh: 我卡住了，這條線索完全看不懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's change our approach.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop staring, spread the clues out.
dialogue.zh: 彆只盯著看，把線索攤開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, spreading them out helps.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，攤開來真的有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This number is also on the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈnʌmbər ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ɑn ðə klɑk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it's a hint, not a code?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪts ə hɪnt, nɑt ə koʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 所以它是提示，不是密碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, ignore clues that repeat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good rule, that's less stressful.
dialogue.zh: 這規矩讓人壓力小多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The countdown says eight minutes now.
dialogue.zh: 倒數顯示現在剩八分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One lock left, but which door?
dialogue.zh: 只剩一把鎖，可是在哪扇門？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's split again, you take this.
dialogue.zh: 我們再分工，你負責這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I'll handle the color puzzle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Colors hide numbers in this game.
dialogue.zh: 這個遊戲裡顏色藏著數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red means one, blue means two?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The note listed every color code.
dialogue.zh: 紙條上列了每個顏色代碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we turn colors into numbers.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們把顏色換成數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The colors add up to one number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌlərz æd ʌp tu wʌn ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 顏色全部加起來是一個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the number on door two!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Follow the glowing trail on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ðə ˈɡloʊɪŋ treɪl ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 跟著地板上發光的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ends right at the door lock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɛndz raɪt æt ðə dɔr lɑk./
dialogue.zh: 它正好停在那扇門的鎖前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door lock wants a real key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr lɑk wɑnts ə ril ki./
dialogue.zh: 門鎖要的是一把真正的鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box gave us one, remember?
dialogue.zh: 那個盒子給了我們一把，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you keep that key safe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, safe in my pocket, see?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, let's beat this final lock!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're so close, don't rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The keyhole is under the handle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here goes, into the lock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now turn it slowly, feel it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turned, I heard a click!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The deadbolt is sliding back!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The door is finally unlocked!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the door with both hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's heavy, but it's moving!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We escaped, we actually made it.
dialogue.zh: 我們逃出來了，真的成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can't believe we won.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our clock stopped at two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was so close and thrilling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The host is smiling at us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We made it with minutes to spare!
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪd ɪt wɪð ˈmɪnɪts tu spɛr!/
dialogue.zh: 我們做到了，還有幾分鐘餘裕！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's take our win photo here.
dialogue.zh: 我們就在這裡拍張勝利照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, gather everyone and smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the door like you just left.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə dɔr laɪk ju dʒʌst lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect shot, that looks great.
dialogue.zh: 這張很棒，看起來太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can she send us the photo?
dialogue.zh: 她能把照片傳給我們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she'll email it tonight.
dialogue.zh: 可以，她今晚會用郵件發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was our total escape time?
dialogue.zh: 我們總共逃了多少時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty-eight minutes, two to spare!
dialogue.zh: 五十八分鐘，還剩兩分鐘！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a good time here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top ten in this room already!
dialogue.zh: 已經進這間房的前十名了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, we beat most teams.
dialogue.zh: 哇，我們贏過大多數隊伍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the leaderboard has our names!
dialogue.zh: 看，排行榜上有我們的名字！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And our win photo is up too!
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈaʊər wɪn ˈfoʊtoʊ ɪz ʌp tu!/
dialogue.zh: 我們的勝利照也上牆了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's honestly the best part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The record here is forty flat.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的紀錄正好四十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we did well for beginners.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們新手來說很好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart won't slow down at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɑrt woʊnt sloʊ daʊn æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我的心到現在還慢不下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, that was intense.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which puzzle felt best to you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The UV light one, hands down.
dialogue.zh: 毫無疑問是紫外燈那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glowing numbers were so cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the hidden word lock stumped us.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ðə ˈhɪdən wɜrd lɑk stʌmpt ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 但那個暗語鎖把我們難住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hint saved us there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, asking helped, no shame.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I liked splitting up to search.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It doubled our speed for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The first note tied the story together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst noʊt taɪd ðə ˈstɔri təˈɡɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 那張最初的紙條串起了故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It led us straight to the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lɛd ʌs streɪt tu ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 它直接把我們帶到盒子前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Getting stuck felt awful at first.
dialogue.zh: 卡住的時候一開始真難受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But stepping back always unlocked it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you enjoy the detective story?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡那個偵探故事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the plot kept us guessing.
dialogue.zh: 喜歡，劇情一直讓我們猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly I want to do it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli aɪ wɑnt tu du ɪt əˈɡɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, right after this one.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，玩完這局馬上再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was it worth the price?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, best money I spent.
dialogue.zh: 超值得，我花得最值的一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we recommend it to friends?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, tell Sam to join next.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's great fun for a group.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than just watching a movie.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should post about it online.
dialogue.zh: 我們該在網上分享一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave a good review for them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The staff were really friendly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the game ran very smoothly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room was clean and neat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every prop looked well made.
dialogue.zh: 每件道具看起來都做得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was hard but fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No puzzle felt unfair to us.
dialogue.zh: 沒有任何謎題讓我們覺得不公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, which theme calls you next?
dialogue.zh: 那麼，哪個主題讓你心動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The prison break looks the hardest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is rated expert, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, only ten percent escape it.
dialogue.zh: 對，只有百分之十的人逃得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low odds, but let's try anyway.
dialogue.zh: 機率很低，但我們還是要試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring two more players for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full teams crack hard rooms faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thinking, let's fill the room.
dialogue.zh: 想得對，我們把房間坐滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's book it for next Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll reserve it on the app now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl rɪˈzɜrv ɪt ɑn ði æp naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about a different company?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this company does great rooms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They have a spooky one too.
dialogue.zh: 他們也有一間鬼屋主題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save that one for Halloween.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll invite my coworker Kate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She loves puzzles, count her in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do experts repeat rooms they did?
dialogue.zh: 高手會重玩玩過的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely, the clues stay the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we need brand new themes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, freshness keeps it fun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel smarter than one hour ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈsmɑrtər ðæn wʌn ˈaʊər əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我覺得比一小時前更聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, my brain is tired but happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm, maɪ breɪn ɪz ˈtaɪərd bət ˈhæpi./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，腦袋累但很快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's get food to celebrate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pizza sounds perfect right now.
dialogue.zh: 現在聽起來披薩最完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs ache from crouching.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, I dug through every drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, aɪ dʌɡ θru ˈɛvri drɔər./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我把每個抽屜都翻遍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That adrenaline is such a rush.
dialogue.zh: 那種腎上腺素讓人大呼過癮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get why people play this.
dialogue.zh: 我懂為什麼大家愛玩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beginners should start with medium.
dialogue.zh: 新手該從中等難度開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We did that, and we loved it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪd ðæt, ænd wi ləvd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們正是這樣，而且超喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, fewer wasted hints.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And better communication throughout.
dialogue.zh: 還有全程都要好好溝通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, a perfect night out, right?
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚外出超完美，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best leisure idea in a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst ˈlɪʒər aɪˈdiə ɪn ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 是近期最棒的休閒點子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for booking the escape room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for coming along too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time next Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Definitely, I'll clear my schedule.
